api.C: brute.certify/34h (NEW: certify/33h bitset preprocess + separating-word policy; no homing batch)

design.jobs: C3: C at plus3, 10 targets x seeds 12740101, 12740102 = 20 (headline); C1: C at plus1, 10 x seed 12740101 = 10; T3: T at plus3, 10 x 2 = 20; 50 jobs. Smoke seed 12740301 (SJ, KR; C1 and T3) not gated
design.memory: RLIMIT_AS = 2.0 GiB per job child; oom_score_adj 1000; MemoryError/signal -> KILL. 3 workers
design.time: SIGKILL at 420 s per job -> KILL; main cap 3300 s; main run once

diagnostic_not_gated: per-target kill reasons and step counts at C3 vs study 073; wall times with short traces

honest_framing: v0.69.0 certify/33h removed the clique-preprocess wall; at N=true+3 it decided 3/20 cells (SJ×2, KR×1), 0 wrong; 14 memory_cap (often pysat int32 allocator) and 3 timeout. Homing batches appended ~400 steps per round and drove T into that SAT wall. The batch was heuristic only (certificate never assumed homing). This version keeps bitset preprocess and drops the batch.

pre_plan_exploration.consequence: Gate thresholds stay at 6 of 20 cells / 3 targets (same as 073). Pilot used seed 12730101 (a study-073 gate seed, not a 074 gate seed). Main seeds are 12740101 and 12740102.
pre_plan_exploration.diagnosis: Study 073 C3 kills: 14 memory_cap (several with MemoryError int32 allocator), 3 timeout. Decided cells used 4052-7329 steps with ~400-step batches. Encoding size grows like T·N².
pre_plan_exploration.fix_check: Ungated certify/34h pilot on seed 12730101 at 2.0 GiB: B5 N=8 IDF 940 steps ~309 s; HK N=8 IDF 940 steps ~307 s; KR N=7 IDF 744 steps ~66 s; JO N=7 TIMEOUT at 300 s (1027 steps, clique 3). No Brute arm ran on 074 gate seeds 12740101/12740102 or on U32/U8S/U16B/EJ4/HZ before the freeze, except the ungated smoke after freeze.

process: LEAN: plan locked before gated data, one main run, exact recount, failures published, one fresh-clone check, no CI, no drills, no host-pause probe
question: With the 400-step homing batch removed (certify/34h = bitset preprocess + separating-word policy only), how many real decoders does Brute decide reset-free at a LOOSE declared N (true+3), soundly, and does the change keep tight-N behaviour?
status_rule: CERTIFIED iff every gate passes; else not certified with failing gates listed
target_software: CPython 3.13.5 incremental decoders via public interface only, no resets
truth: experiments/truth_074.json (same oracle machines as truth_073; new schema tag)
what_this_cannot_show: No noise; sizes 3-10 states; N=true+3 uses oracle sizes; two seeds; 2.0 GiB and 420 s are runner caps; guarantee conditional on N and clean readings; pilot used a 073 seed
